body:
This adds the `start-marathon` preparation workflow while retaining explicit authorization for firing work and the legacy `marathon-triage` alias. It also adds root `PARKED/` intake, narrows standup parsing to structured records, and introduces the mechanical per-wave QA check from #784.

Closes #762.
Closes #784.

## Integration remediation

The GH-796 review found six integration problems. This revision resolves them in the existing checker, skill and controls:

- `--pre-pr --wave N` admits a completed wave while future waves remain pending; final closeout still requires all waves.
- The #777 plan has the required proof/reviewer structure and current skill paths, with unfinished work unchecked.
- The production inventory admits exactly the reviewed checker addition and retains the earlier GitHub connector repair.
- Checker and dispatcher use the consumer root for receipts and activity logs.
- Markdown and backtick receipt links work; missing, empty, unreadable and nonterminal receipts fail.
- Current ledger history and completed #764 state are preserved through the existing writer, with only distinct #762/#763 intake replayed.

The receipt check does not establish independent authorship or exact-SHA review. **#777 remains open**; this change does not complete its remaining adoption and final acceptance work.

## Verification

Final candidate `aa59ea0350842b2e08692bfce2f1f58b3842944a` passed the full combined local macOS gate **422/422** in 1081 seconds, including the Python layer **21/21**. The installed pre-push gate ran in a separate disposable full clone; the normal push succeeded and pre/post HEAD, origin, bare state, config and cleanliness matched. Retained full gate logs and provenance are committed with GH-796 integration evidence in PR #799. Hosted CI is [run 36113131036](https://github.com/HiQS-Labs/XYZ-forge/actions/runs/36113131036) passed its smoke job for this exact head. Hosted macOS promotion was skipped and is not claimed.

Agy approved all seven bounded final-integration questions through the shipped relay driver (exit 0, one turn), reviewing source at `902aa29d`; the committed attestation is in `relay-system/2026-09-25/gh796-pr765-final-integration-qa.md`. Later candidate changes contain the review report and documentation/evidence only.

Earlier focused verification at `0e9c4b88` passed GH-784, hook routing, the installer matrix, standup (153/153), the inventory ratchet and PDDA (0 errors), including retained negative controls. Source, integration-writer and review evidence/provenance are committed under `TESTS-RESULTS/2026-09-24+GH-796-PR765/` and `TESTS-RESULTS/2026-09-25+GH-796-PR765/`.

Historical draft publication used `--no-verify` and had baseline/toolchain failures plus an unattested closeout mismatch. Those records remain in the committed transcripts; they are not the final qualification. #763 tracks the closeout issue; #764 is already closed and its completed state is preserved.

## Scope and rollback

This changes preparation/routing, governance and its checker, with no marathon executor rewrite or automatic dispatch. The code and skill changes are reversible through a normal revert; live skill deployment uses the normal Skills Army process. Unrelated PRs remain outside this merge batch.
title: Start marathon: reviewed preparation routing and dry-run workflow
